headline: Just the audio from your videos.
intro: Extract audio from videos, and convert audio you already have. From trimming and merging to batch conversion, everything happens on your iPhone or iPad.
extractBody: Choose a file from ‘Photos’ or ‘Files’ and save it as audio. You can also convert several files at once.
editTitle: Keep only the part you need
editBody: Trim the section you want to keep, or join several files in whatever order you like.
localBody: No account is needed to process audio. Everything is free, and there are no ads in the app.
requirements: For iPhone and iPad (iOS and iPadOS 17 or later)
helpIntro: This guide covers the steps from importing to saving, and what to check when a conversion does not work.
startBody: Import a file from ‘Home’, select it and tap ‘Extract audio’. Choose a format and save it, and the audio you created appears in ‘Library’.
shareTitle: How do I use saved audio in other apps?
shareBody: Open the menu for the audio you created in ‘Library’, then choose ‘Save to Files’ or Share.
failureTitle: What if I cannot import or convert?
failureBody: Check that the video has an audio track and that your device has free space. For files stored in the cloud, wait for the download to finish. Items that failed to convert can be tried again from ‘Progress’.
contactBody: Please tell us your device model, your OS and app versions, the file format, the steps you took, and any error shown. You do not need to attach the original video or audio.
policyIntro: This policy applies to the OtoNuki app and to this official website.
processingBody: The app processes and stores the videos and audio you select, and the audio it creates, on your device. There is no feature that sends files to the developer’s servers. If you choose a file stored in the cloud, it may be downloaded from the original service so that it can be imported to your device.
collectionBody: The app does not collect usage data and does not use data for advertising or tracking. No account registration is required.
controlBody: Media imported into the app and audio saved in it can be deleted within the app. Copies exported to ‘Files’ or other apps must be managed at their destination. Services you share to are governed by their own policies.
websiteBody: This site is published on GitHub Pages. GitHub records visitors’ IP addresses for security. This site has no advertising or analytics tools.
policyContactBody: If you contact us by email, we use your email address and the contents of your message to reply and handle your enquiry. We retain them for as long as necessary to handle it. If you have any privacy questions or would like us to delete the email address and message contents you sent, please contact us at the address below.
